subject: Quick question about the extra delivery slot
text: Hi there, Hope your week is going well. I wanted to flag a tiny issue on my end, not a complaint, just so you know why this month looks a little uneven. After our last conversation, I booked the extra delivery slot you suggested, which worked perfectly. What I didn't count on was the little surcharge that appears when a job is scheduled outside the usual window. It wasn't in the quote I had saved, and I completely forgot to ask whether that kind of request carries a fee. I don't mind covering it because the extra time kept everything on track, but it did surprise me when the revised statement arrived. Could you point me to where those off-hours charges are listed? I'm trying to keep my own records tidy before the next round of invoices. If there's a cheaper way to request a similar slot in the future, I'd be happy to use it. Sorry for making this such a big deal; the service itself was excellent, and I really appreciate how quickly you responded. No rush on this, just when you have a second. In the meantime, I’ve already sent the payment for the main work, and I’ll settle the small difference separately once you confirm the amount. Also, if that surcharge only applies to one-time additions rather than recurring bookings, please let me know. I’m planning a few follow-up tasks for next month and I’d rather ask before assuming. Thanks for all your help, and for being patient with my silly little question.
